objective: Four source kinds through optional independent adapters, actual invocation, sealed evidence, native AutoBenchTS evaluation and same-Run rescoring

core.reason: All real source differences fit existing provider interfaces, source lifecycle, clocks, opaque native payloads, scoped artifacts and fixed evaluation snapshots.

actual_native_sources.generator: Existing frozen-core quickstart; forecast/counter plus late-outcome same-Run rescore
actual_native_sources.dataset: Official Monash tourism_monthly fixed Hub commit, 3 selected series; local_files and save_to_disk freeze also executed offline
actual_native_sources.simulator: Real Gymnasium FrozenLake/CartPole, native termination and scope boundary, final state/reward retained, 6 successful Runs and same-Run rescore
actual_native_sources.live_openenv: Real official Echo and Connect4 servers with official persistent WS SDK, actual rewards/done retained; rescore without installed SDK or live server
actual_native_sources.live_prometheus: Real Prometheus 3.15.0 scraping local exporter, 11 decisions, independent explicit fixture reference, same-Run rescore with no HTTP

failure_evidence: HF missing snapshot sealed failed Run
Real OpenEnv SDK timeout unknown/possible; no resend or reconnect
Real Prometheus HTTP 400 raw rejection preserved in failed Run; attached server left alive
adapter_decisions: Format/projection/private-reference handling stays in HF adapter
Native act once and observe cached state; neutral interaction domain stays external
Missing reward is null and missing cause remains unknown; scope_limited separate from native flags
OpenEnv official persistent WS sessions; close own session and leave attached host
Prometheus inclusive range end filtered to half-open windows; receipt availability and wall clock recorded separately
History cache coverage tracked per variable; oversized-response prefix and truncation retained
backwards_compatibility: Existing six adapters remain independently installable/enableable, all eleven coexist; no frozen core source changes
limitations: HF supports materialized finite one-dimensional numeric forecasting views, not every HF modality or streaming dataset
Monash view is an explicit 3-row local evaluation projection, not a complete official benchmark result
Gymnasium validation uses fixed actions and one episode per Run, not vector/autoreset or new RL backend training
OpenEnv/Prometheus acceptance is against real localhost services; production endpoints and authentication are not configured
Prometheus fixture reference and sample-time forecast Task establish integration only, not causal online forecast quality
Agent autonomous tool-selection loop and full remote/isolation/recovery Runtime require separate acceptance
New native packages use optional runtime dependencies; skipped minimal-environment tests are reported separately from their native suites
